from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import copy
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import importlib
import inspect
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
from typing import get_type_hints

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
DIR = BACKEND / "app/infrastructure/imports"
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND / "scripts"))
from verify_backend_quality_budgets import measure_source

PREFIX = "app.infrastructure.imports.passport_excel_"
archive = json.loads((OUT / "passport-excel-architecture-original-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["sources"]
old_source = archive["backend/app/infrastructure/imports/passport_excel_importer.py"]["source"]
old_tree = ast.parse(old_source)
old_class = next(node for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "PassportExcelImporter")
old_methods = {node.name: node for node in old_class.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
constants = {node.target.id for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign)}
state_fields = {"imported", "readable_sheet_count", "total_rows", "total_populated_cells", "total_metadata_characters"}
row_fields = {"worksheet", "scanned_rows", "headers", "metadata_headers", "data_rows", "formula_rows", "first_row_number"}
modules = {name: importlib.import_module(PREFIX + name) for name in ["importer", "catalog", "records", "rows", "limits", "worksheets", "formula"]}
sources = {name: (DIR / f"passport_excel_{name}.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") for name in modules}
trees = {name: ast.parse(source) for name, source in sources.items()}
methods = {node.name: (owner, node) for owner, tree in trees.items() for cls in tree.body if isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef) for node in cls.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}


class Normalize(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Attribute(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id in {"catalog", "state", "rows"}:
            allowed = {"catalog": constants, "state": state_fields, "rows": row_fields}[node.value.id]
            assert node.attr in allowed, (node.value.id, node.attr)
            return ast.copy_location(ast.Name(id=node.attr, ctx=node.ctx), node)
        return self.generic_visit(node)

    def visit_AnnAssign(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id == "formula_columns" and ast.unparse(node.annotation) == "frozenset[int]":
            assert ast.unparse(node.value) == "frozenset()"
            return ast.copy_location(ast.Assign(targets=[node.target], value=node.value), node)
        return self.generic_visit(node)


def normalized(node):
    return Normalize().visit(copy.deepcopy(node))


def is_self_call(node, name):
    return isinstance(node, ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value.func.value, ast.Name) and node.value.func.value.id == "self" and node.value.func.attr == name


row_collector = copy.deepcopy(methods["_collect_passenger_rows"][1])
sheet_collector = copy.deepcopy(methods["_collect_worksheet"][1])
quota_expansions = 0


class ExpandUnmappedQuota(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Expr(self, node):
        global quota_expansions
        if is_self_call(node, "_charge_unmapped_row"):
            assert [ast.unparse(item) for item in node.value.args] == ["state", "text_values"]
            assert {item.arg for item in node.value.keywords} == {"formula_columns", "formula_source_characters"}
            assert all(ast.unparse(item.value) == item.arg for item in node.value.keywords)
            quota_expansions += 1
            body = copy.deepcopy(methods["_charge_unmapped_row"][1].body)
            assert isinstance(body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(body[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(body[0].value.value, str)
            return body[1:]
        return self.generic_visit(node)


sheet_collector = ExpandUnmappedQuota().visit(sheet_collector)
assert quota_expansions == 3
row_call = sheet_collector.body[-1]
assert is_self_call(row_call, "_collect_passenger_rows")
assert len(row_call.value.args) == 2 and not row_call.value.keywords
row_data, state_arg = row_call.value.args
assert isinstance(row_data, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(row_data.func) == "_PassportExcelWorksheetRows"
assert not row_data.args and {keyword.arg for keyword in row_data.keywords} == row_fields
assert all(isinstance(keyword.value, ast.Name) and keyword.value.id == keyword.arg for keyword in row_data.keywords)
assert ast.unparse(state_arg) == "state"
sheet_collector.body[-1:] = copy.deepcopy(row_collector.body)
converted_returns = 0


class RestoreSheetContinue(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Return(self, node):
        global converted_returns
        assert node.value is None
        converted_returns += 1
        return ast.copy_location(ast.Continue(), node)


sheet_collector = RestoreSheetContinue().visit(sheet_collector)
assert converted_returns == 2
expanded = copy.deepcopy(methods["import_rows"][1])
old_initializers = [node for node in ast.walk(old_methods["import_rows"]) if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) and ((isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id in state_fields) or (isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id in state_fields))]
assert len(old_initializers) == 5
state_initializations = 0
sheet_expansions = 0


class ExpandWorkbook(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        global state_initializations
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id == "state":
            assert ast.unparse(node.value) == "_PassportExcelImportState()"
            state_initializations += 1
            return copy.deepcopy(old_initializers)
        return self.generic_visit(node)

    def visit_Expr(self, node):
        global sheet_expansions
        if is_self_call(node, "_collect_worksheet"):
            assert [ast.unparse(item) for item in node.value.args] == ["worksheet", "formula_worksheet", "state"]
            assert not node.value.keywords
            sheet_expansions += 1
            return copy.deepcopy(sheet_collector.body)
        return self.generic_visit(node)


expanded = normalized(ExpandWorkbook().visit(expanded))
assert state_initializations == sheet_expansions == 1
assert ast.dump(expanded) == ast.dump(old_methods["import_rows"])
unchanged = []
for name, node in old_methods.items():
    if name != "import_rows":
        assert ast.dump(normalized(methods[name][1])) == ast.dump(node), name
        unchanged.append(name)

# Each pure catalog definition, record and policy assignment is the original AST.
catalog_nodes = {node.name: node for node in trees["catalog"].body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
records_nodes = {node.name: node for node in trees["records"].body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)}
for node in old_tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        assert ast.dump(catalog_nodes[node.name]) == ast.dump(node)
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name != "PassportExcelImporter":
        current = catalog_nodes[node.name] if node.name in catalog_nodes else records_nodes[node.name]
        assert ast.dump(current) == ast.dump(node)
    elif isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign):
        current = next(item for item in trees["catalog"].body if isinstance(item, ast.AnnAssign) and item.target.id == node.target.id)
        assert ast.dump(current) == ast.dump(node)
field_assignment = next(node for node in old_class.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "FIELD_KEYS" for target in node.targets))
assert any(isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and ast.dump(node) == ast.dump(field_assignment) for node in ast.walk(trees["rows"]))

facade = modules["importer"]
public = facade.PassportExcelImporter
assert public.__module__ == PREFIX + "importer"
assert public.HEADER_ALIASES is modules["catalog"]._HEADER_ALIASES
assert public.FIELD_KEYS is modules["rows"]._PassportExcelRows.FIELD_KEYS
for name in constants:
    assert getattr(facade, name) is getattr(modules["catalog"], name)
for name in old_methods:
    actual = getattr(public, name)
    assert actual.__module__ == PREFIX + methods[name][0]
    assert inspect.signature(actual) == inspect.signature(getattr(public(), name).__func__)
    assert getattr(public(), name).__func__ is actual
    get_type_hints(actual)
for name in ["_collect_worksheet", "_collect_passenger_rows", "_charge_unmapped_row"]:
    get_type_hints(getattr(public, name))
for name in ["_PassportExcelImportState", "_PassportExcelWorksheetRows"]:
    get_type_hints(getattr(modules["records"], name))
assert {field.name for field in dataclasses.fields(modules["records"]._PassportExcelImportState)} == state_fields
assert {field.name for field in dataclasses.fields(modules["records"]._PassportExcelWorksheetRows)} == row_fields
assert modules["records"]._PassportExcelImportState().imported is not modules["records"]._PassportExcelImportState().imported

# Evaluate the captured original without invoking any parser, workbook fixture,
# database or provider; compare actual runtime annotations and shared imports.
original_module = ModuleType(PREFIX + "importer")
original_module.__package__ = "app.infrastructure.imports"
exec(compile(old_source, "archived/passport_excel_importer.py", "exec"), original_module.__dict__)
global_bindings = []
for name, old_method in old_methods.items():
    fragments = [name] if name != "import_rows" else ["import_rows", "_collect_worksheet", "_collect_passenger_rows", "_charge_unmapped_row"]
    old_names = {node.id for node in ast.walk(old_method) if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load) and node.id in original_module.__dict__}
    for dependency in sorted(old_names):
        matched = False
        for fragment in fragments:
            actual_function = getattr(public, fragment)
            current_node = methods[fragment][1]
            if dependency in constants:
                used = any(isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name) and node.value.id == "catalog" and node.attr == dependency for node in ast.walk(current_node))
                if used:
                    assert getattr(actual_function.__globals__["catalog"], dependency) is getattr(facade, dependency)
                    matched = True
            elif any(isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load) and node.id == dependency for node in ast.walk(current_node)):
                expected = getattr(facade, dependency) if dependency in {"ImportedPassportRow", "PassportExcelImportError", "_header_identity", "_normalized_header_text", "_canonicalize_numeric_date_separators"} else original_module.__dict__[dependency]
                assert actual_function.__globals__[dependency] is expected, (name, fragment, dependency)
                matched = True
        assert matched, (name, dependency)
        global_bindings.append({"old_method": name, "dependency": dependency, "actual_owner_binding_proved": True})
assert public.import_rows.__globals__["_PassportExcelImportState"] is modules["records"]._PassportExcelImportState
assert public._collect_worksheet.__globals__["_PassportExcelWorksheetRows"] is modules["records"]._PassportExcelWorksheetRows
for owner, tree in trees.items():
    if owner != "importer":
        assert not any(isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "passport_excel_importer" for node in tree.body)
assert {key: repr(value) for key, value in get_type_hints(facade).items()} == {key: repr(value) for key, value in get_type_hints(original_module).items()}
for name in ["ImportedPassportRow", "PassportExcelImportError", "_HeaderAlias"]:
    actual = getattr(facade, name)
    original_type = getattr(original_module, name)
    assert actual.__module__ == original_type.__module__
    assert actual.__qualname__ == original_type.__qualname__
    assert get_type_hints(actual) == get_type_hints(original_type)
    if name != "PassportExcelImportError":
        assert inspect.signature(actual) == inspect.signature(original_type)
    else:
        assert actual.__init__ is original_type.__init__
    assert not hasattr(actual, "__table__")
for name in [node.name for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)]:
    assert getattr(facade, name) is getattr(modules["catalog"], name)
    assert {key: repr(value) for key, value in get_type_hints(getattr(facade, name)).items()} == {key: repr(value) for key, value in get_type_hints(getattr(original_module, name)).items()}

caller_bindings = []
for module_name, name in [
    ("app.presentation.api.v1.routes.passports", "ImportedPassportRow"),
    ("app.presentation.api.v1.routes.passport_excel_import_support", "ImportedPassportRow"),
    ("app.presentation.api.v1.routes.passport_routes.excel_import", "ImportedPassportRow"),
    ("app.presentation.api.v1.routes.passport_routes.excel_import", "PassportExcelImporter"),
    ("app.application.mcp.group_workbook_source", "PassportExcelImporter"),
    ("app.application.mcp.group_workbook_plan", "ImportedPassportRow"),
    ("app.presentation.mcp.group_workbook_tools", "PassportExcelImportError"),
]:
    assert getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name), name) is getattr(facade, name)
    caller_bindings.append({"caller": module_name, "name": name, "same_public_object": True})

# Check class and instance override lookup using ordinary descriptor identity;
# do not create or execute any additional workbook or adversarial fixture.
sentinel = lambda *_args, **_kwargs: "override"
instance = public()
instance._stringify = sentinel
assert instance._stringify is sentinel
subclass = type("ExistingOverrideContract", (public,), {"_stringify": sentinel})
assert subclass._stringify is sentinel
assert subclass()._stringify.__func__ is sentinel
old_self_calls = [ast.dump(node.func) for node in ast.walk(old_methods["import_rows"]) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name) and node.func.value.id == "self"]
expanded_self_calls = [ast.dump(node.func) for node in ast.walk(expanded) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name) and node.func.value.id == "self"]
assert expanded_self_calls == old_self_calls

for name in ["passport_excel_formula.py"]:
    path = DIR / name
    before = archive[str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")]
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before["sha256"]
test_path = ROOT / "backend/tests/unit/infrastructure/test_passport_excel_importer.py"
before_test = archive[str(test_path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")]["source"]
expected_test = before_test.replace("import app.infrastructure.imports.passport_excel_importer as importer_module", "import app.infrastructure.imports.passport_excel_catalog as importer_module")
assert test_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == expected_test.replace("\r\n", "\n")
old_assertions = [ast.dump(node) for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(before_test)) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
current_assertions = [ast.dump(node) for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(test_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
assert current_assertions == old_assertions

runtime_paths = [DIR / f"passport_excel_{name}.py" for name in modules]
bound_sources = [{"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "lines": len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())} for path in [*runtime_paths, test_path]]
measurements = [dataclasses.asdict(measure_source(path, str(path.relative_to(BACKEND)).replace("\\", "/"))) for path in runtime_paths]
assert all(item["lines"] < 300 for item in measurements)
proof = {"original_sha256": archive["backend/app/infrastructure/imports/passport_excel_importer.py"]["sha256"], "unchanged_original_methods_after_only_catalog_qualification": unchanged, "fully_expanded_import_rows_ast_equal": True, "expanded_statement_movement": {"typed_state_initialization_expanded": state_initializations, "sheet_calls_expanded": sheet_expansions, "sheet_return_to_original_continue": converted_returns, "passenger_row_calls_expanded": 1, "duplicate_unmapped_quota_blocks_expanded": quota_expansions, "row_data_fields_exactly_bound": sorted(row_fields), "per_import_data_fields_exactly_bound": sorted(state_fields), "formula_columns_local_annotation_only": "frozenset[int] restores the original broad function's inference context"}, "old_self_calls_preserved_in_exact_order": len(old_self_calls), "actual_old_method_descriptors_bound": len(old_methods), "actual_public_module_and_class_annotation_contracts_equal": True, "new_helper_and_data_annotations_evaluated": True, "pure_functions_policy_assignments_and_three_original_record_class_asts_equal": True, "public_class_paths_and_final_constant_alias_identity": True, "class_and_instance_override_lookup_preserved": True, "actual_caller_bindings": caller_bindings, "actual_global_bindings": global_bindings, "no_implementation_owner_imports_public_facade": True, "formula_helper_current_sha_unchanged": True, "test_edit": "One instrumentation import retarget only; all other source and assertions exact after LF normalization", "original_assertions_unchanged": len(old_assertions), "no_new_workbook_or_adversarial_fixture": True, "bound_sources": bound_sources, "measurements": measurements}
(OUT / "passport-excel-architecture-extraction-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
